title: 9, 33 & 47 Erb St W (OPA 64 & Z-25-17)
body:
Application to amend zoning for 9, 33 & 47 Erb Street West
Changes to the Official Plan and the Zoning Bylaw for this location are required before a permit can be issued. This means that they submit an application that is reviewed by city planners and other agencies plus city council before anything can be built.
Atrium Waterloo Limited Partnership (Momentum Developments) is proposing to build a new mixed-use building at 9, 33 & 47 Erb Street West. The plan includes 39 storey building containing 454 dwelling units, ground-floor commercial space and 933 square metres of outdoor/indoor amenity space atop the podium.
Official plan changes requested include:
increase the tower height to 39 storeys
Zoning bylaw changes requested include:
increasing the maximum building height to 122.2 m (39-storeys)
increasing the maximum density to 3,565 bedrooms per hectare
allowing a driveway to be located on the adjacent lot (via easement)
reducing the minimum rear yard setback to 0.68m
reducing the tower separation to 3.46m for an interior lot line (include balconies)
allow a 0m tower step back.
remove the Holding (H) symbol related to railway proximity
View the documents submitted by the development company under supporting documents on this page for more details and drawings.
Building height, units, housing types
Building Height: 39 storeys
Number of units: 454
Unit sizes: mix of studio units (7%) one-bedrooms (60%), two-bedrooms (23%) and three-bedrooms (10%)
Housing types: apartments
Non-residential floor space
Commercial space: 248 square m
Parking
Parking: 102 [combination of underground and 4-level structured parking podium]
Bicycle parking: 248
You can provide feedback to the planning department, and it will be shared with the council, or ask a question to learn more about this application.
Images are provided by the applicant and may not reflect the final design approved by the planning division.
